procedure: adolion-fresh is not needed: this corpus has no cast or lore. Seed a lane (never lane 0), image and sprites off.
Import saga-mini.story.json into a fresh group chat; set the arm's three switches and chronicleTokens.
Replay the transcript with /sendas + the boundary per message (so-scenario seed_metadata is not enough: seals run at boundaries).
Wait for schedulerIdle after c10 -> c11 so the ch3 seal lands; record chapter records, token counts and model-call counts (Q-M2, Q-M7).
Capture the ch4 generation payload (st-payload arm --persist) for Q-M3.
Ask the 30 questions as the player at c11, one fresh swipe each, score with the accept regexes (Q-M1, Q-M4).
Run each arm twice consecutively on one lane; archive under test/measurements/v2.6-07/runs/<arm>/.
